response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and versatility across multiple domains, but his experience lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of a Principal Performance Architect role, particularly in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, and hardware-software co-design. His background in full-stack development, AI-agent infrastructure, and open-source GIS tools shows adaptability, but the role demands deeper expertise in performance analysis for deep-learning workloads and hardware optimization.
strengths: Diverse technical experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems, indicating adaptability and broad problem-solving skills.
Strong open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) and community engagement, demonstrating initiative and technical leadership.
Experience with low-latency systems and performance-critical applications (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic, real-time note-taking tools).
concerns: No explicit experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or hardware-software co-design, which are critical for the role.
Lacks a PhD or equivalent deep technical experience in performance architecture for AI workloads, as preferred in the job description.
Background is heavily skewed toward software development (full-stack, web, mobile) rather than hardware or cloud infrastructure optimization.

key_factors.factor: no direct AI accelerator optimization experience
